content.comment_body: I have a similar question, but couldn't find the answer here. I've worked with [product_name] for about 10 years and now have the [article_no]. When using the app to switch an output, everything functions correctly, except that I have to enter a box to change the value through the 'edit set tag value' option. What is the permissible value for toggling a Network Input with address V3.1? When I use the Variables menu, entering 1 or 0 works and the input changes on the module, but the button won't perform the same change. Thanks, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user has solid experience with [product_name], but is facing a challenge changing a Network Input value using the app. Direct entry in the Variables menu works as intended, but using a button fails to make the same change, indicating a usability or consistency issue in the app interface for this function.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that pressing a button in the app should allow for changing the value of a Network Input, and seeks guidance on what the correct values are to achieve this.
